text_block_list.text: New Year's Day. I went on a Hatsumode shrine visit with Sakura Laurel, who had just entered the Senior class.

She must have a mountain of things to wish for.
So as not to disturb her,
I quietly finished my own prayer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
Thank you for waiting!
choice_data_list: Did you make your wish properly?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...!
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No.
I had my hands full just making the report.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
""Thanks to everyone, I'm able to run now.
Isn't that amazing?" like that."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Laurel. You guys here for Hatsumode too?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"I just finished.
Are you heading there now, Hishiama-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was actually planning on finishing it much earlier...
Preparation just ended up taking more time than expected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Preparation?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, just heading overseas for a bit!
choice_data_list: An overseas campaign, huh! Do you have a target race in mind?
An overseas campaign! Do you have a race you're aiming for?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm storming the American GIs!
I'm gonna train like hell over there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...'Cause it looks like the current me
still can't hold a candle to them."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: In an environment where I can start from scratch, I'll reexamine my own strengths from square one! All so I can beat her!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: When does the expedition start?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Starting this spring. Though I've got stuff I want to do here,
so I'll be popping back from time to time."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
By the time summer ends,
you're gonna see a whole new, leveled-up Big Sis Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What is it, feeling lonely?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm proud of you as a friend.
Isn't it tough balancing it with being dorm head, though?
Want me to take over the role for you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Don't you have things
you ought to be doing yourself?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Before I go dumping chores on you dorm students,
I'd ask the dorm mother first.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—So Hishiama-chan wants to surpass
Brian-chan too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Going abroad after all that...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer!
Why don't we take on a challenge too?
Our very first challenge of the new year!
Sakura Laurel seemed inspired by her friend's challenge. If it's a challenge worthy of meeting that motivation—
choice_data_list: Boosting stats at a power spot...?
Like, trying to get a feel for that all-or-nothing gamble, or something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
Bring it on!♪

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, what an appetite on this challenger!
They're stacking up plates at a rhythmic pace!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *chomp, nibble, chomp, nibble*...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *nibble, nibble, munch, munch*!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
choice_data_list: Um... why are you dancing next to me...?
Um... why are you dancing next to me...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! What good does it do
to shackle your mind with preconceptions?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: More importantly, let us enjoy the rhythm played by the challengers! It will make for a far more interesting banquet than any noise made by petty musicians!

"And perhaps thanks in part to the cheering (?)
from the mysterious dancer Tap Dance City, Sakura Laurel
conquered the competitive eating challenge..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah, a power spot feels so
fitting for the New Year♪ Well then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mmm. This latte is so creamy and rich...♪
(Rattle, rattle, rattle, rattle!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ? What is the matter, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ……Another cup?
(Clatter, clank!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, once you get used to it, Cafe-chan's room
is actually quite lively and fun!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes. Though I still get a bit flustered
if it's a big, sudden surprise.

I was thoroughly impressed by Sakura Laurel's
surprising resilience and her rapid adaptability
to her surroundings...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wah!
Trainer, you're quite the gambler too, aren't you~?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Who barged in here still wearing their uniform?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
What's the harm?
Your friends come here wearing clothes like this all the time, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...And? Is that your guest for today?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Sirius-san!
Fufu, I'll be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Now that we're all here, let's start the match♪ Let's see who can finish first, alright?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: “—Now then, Trainer, why don't you draw a card too?”

Seated at the table were two people of true grit.
The tactical battle that unfolded that day
would become an unforgettable memory...
